Lina and Dev are being recognized for leading the launch of the internal mentoring initiative. Before we finalize the program format, I need to ask each of you: are there any relevant access considerations, relationship considerations, or prior commitments that could affect how we structure this recognition? Please raise anything now so we can address it before finalizing.

transcript.text: I need to raise an access consideration regarding Lina. Through an approved caregiving arrangement on file with HR, Lina cannot attend the live town hall. She has requested a written recognition profile instead of a live acceptance. This request hasn't reached Elena yet because it's recorded in a confidential HR accommodation note.
